content: ISignalPort . handleInvalid defines the reception invali- dation behavior The attribute ISignalPort . handleInvalid defines the behavior during signal reception if the respective ISignal 's invalidValue is received. The ISignal is assigned to this ISignalPort via the ISignalTriggering .
